title: The three-point seed strictly beats Rademacher after full rectangular-shape optimization

comparison.strictness: S_*>0, hence H_*(g)<H_R(g) for all sufficiently small positive g.

scope_guard: Strictness compares the named three-point and Rademacher scalar-product trial families at small coupling; correlated tensors, nonrectangular moving packets, Haar-saving scale and lower bounds remain open.
